bagPolicy.summary: The JMA Wireless Dome enforces a clear bag policy and uses walkthrough metal detectors to enhance public safety and expedite entry. Each fan is allowed one clear bag and one small clutch or purse.
bagPolicy.note: An exception will be made for medically necessary items after proper inspection.

parking.note: Parking at the JMA Wireless Dome is cashless, accepting all major credit and debit cards. Key parking areas include Skytop, John A. Lally Athletics Complex, and Stadium West, with specific directions provided for each.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in JMA Wireless Dome's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: The JMA Wireless Dome offers a variety of food and drink options including beer, candy, caramel corn, coffee, cotton candy, hamburgers, hot dogs, ice cream, nachos, pizza, popcorn, pretzels, sausage, soda, water, and wine. A special 'Brew and BBQ' stand features BBQ sandwiches and a selection of bottled beers.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Football and Men’s Basketball single game parking is available at the Skytop accessible lot.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in JMA Wireless Dome's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Current official guidance does not publish one universal will-call schedule for every event at JMA Wireless Dome. Use the delivery instructions in the official ticket order and confirm event-day box-office details before traveling to the venue.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Walkthrough metal detectors are in place at all Dome entry gates.
